label: clear a patch of twigs, weeds and stones beside the farmhouse for the first crops (race them: who clears more before noon)
procedure: patch: gather(debris) beside the house until 8+ tiles are open, then till

label: get the first parsnips in the ground (their 15 seeds are in the farmhouse chest: they plant, you till and water)
next_action: till 15 tiles in the cleared patch and water what they plant
procedure: first crops: till the cleared patch -> the player plants their chest seeds -> water every tile

label: harvest the parsnips when they are ready (4 days) and have them dropped in the shipping bin by the house; the gold arrives overnight
next_action: harvest() when the crops read READY
procedure: harvest: water daily, harvest() on the READY day, the player ships it in the bin

label: gather 50 wood (a chest costs 50; the player crafts it from the crafting menu)
next_action: gather(wood) from the trees and twigs on the farm
procedure: wood: gather(wood, 50) on the farm; hand it over for a chest

label: forage the spring goods lying around (leeks, dandelions, horseradish on the farm and in the forest south of it): free food and first gold
next_action: gather(forage) around the farm, then the Forest
procedure: forage: gather(forage, 5) on the farm, then goTo Forest and again

label: walk to town together (the bus stop east of the farm, then east again): Pierre's shop, the saloon, the community center
next_action: goTo(location: Town) with the player following, or follow them there
procedure: town: Farm -> BusStop -> Town by the east paths

label: buy seeds at Pierre's with your own gold (parsnips 20g, potatoes 50g, cauliflower 80g; closed Wednesdays)
procedure: seeds: goTo SeedShop 9AM-5PM (not Wednesday) -> buy() -> plant on the farm

label: catch a fish with the bamboo pole (the river at the south edge of the farm, or the ocean at the beach)
procedure: fish: stand by water, fish(casts: 3); 8 energy a cast

label: the mines open on spring 5: go down to level 5 together for copper, sword out, with food in the bag
next_action: goTo(location: Mountain), then the mine entrance north, then interact(ladder)
procedure: mines: Mountain -> Mine -> break rocks for the ladder each level -> level 5

label: mine 20 copper ore for a furnace (20 copper + 25 stone; the player crafts it)
next_action: mine() the orange copper nodes on levels 1-10
procedure: copper: mine copper nodes on mine levels 2-10 until 20 ore
